name: condo-repair-comparison-cloudflare
description: Compare condominium repair proposals and simulate monthly contributions.

interface.longDescription: Compare condominium repair proposals in ChatGPT and understand what each option adds to every unit’s monthly contribution. Attach supplier proposals in the conversation. Condo presents prices, stated taxes, scope and terms with document references, keeping missing information explicit. Add all unit identifiers, permillage and current monthly quotas, or choose an assumed equal split using a unit count. Compare 12 months and through December of the starting year. Supports English, Portuguese and Spanish. Creates a simulation; it does not create charges or contact suppliers.
defaultPrompt: Compare my condominium repair proposals and show the monthly contribution for each unit.
